en.headline: Eighteen lightly hurt after minibus hits works vehicle on Fanling Highway
en.dek: The Transport Department closed Kowloon-bound lanes near Choi Yuen Estate after a morning collision; the minibus driver was trapped and later freed.
body: About 18 people suffered minor injuries after a public light bus collided with a works vehicle on Fanling Highway near Choi Yuen Estate in Sheung Shui on Monday morning, RTHK reported. Other local outlets put the number of injured at about 20, most of them lightly hurt.

The crash happened at about 8.50am as a green-top scheduled minibus travelled Kowloon-bound and struck a special-purpose works vehicle carrying excavation equipment, according to reports citing the scene. The minibus then veered and hit a stone barrier on the fast lane. Its front was badly damaged and smoke was seen coming from the vehicle. The driver was trapped and later freed by rescuers.

The Transport Department said all Kowloon-bound lanes of Fanling Highway near Choi Yuen Estate were closed after the accident and traffic built up, with queues at one point stretching towards Kwu Tung. Motorists were advised to use other roads. Police said they were investigating the cause.
Most of those hurt were minibus passengers. Initial reports said the injured were taken to North District Hospital and Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital.

zh.headline: 粉嶺公路小巴撼工程車 18人輕傷 往九龍方向一度全線封閉
zh.dek: 今早近九時上水彩園邸對開發生車禍，專線小巴司機一度被困，運輸署封閉粉嶺公路往九龍方向近彩園邸全線。
body: 粉嶺公路今早近上水彩園邸發生車禍，港台報道18人受輕傷。其他本地媒體則指約20人受傷，大部分屬輕傷。
事發約早上8時50分，一輛綠頂專線小巴沿粉嶺公路往九龍方向行駛，與一輛運載挖掘設備的特別用途工程車相撞。報道指小巴其後衝向快線石壩，車頭嚴重損毀並冒煙，司機一度被困，其後由救援人員救出。
運輸署表示，粉嶺公路往九龍方向近彩園邸全線封閉，現場交通擠塞，車龍一度延伸至古洞一帶，呼籲驗駛人士改用其他道路。警方正調查意外原因。
傷者大多為小巴乘客，初步報道指傷者分別送往北區醫院及大埔那打素醫院治理。
